about: call.shouldSkipWait (Python should_skip_wait, Go ShouldSkipWait): whether a tool skips a wait the agent asked for (a vendor's wait_seconds) and returns at once. True only when call.wakes is true and the wait reaches call.callLimit, the program's per-call limit in seconds (null: not known). seconds null: no wait was asked for. Each SDK runs every case on a stand-in call made with wakes and call_limit, after one subscribe.
